title: Dimitri Forces One Step Back
prompt:
Dimitri 逼黑鹫前排退半步，Dedue 稳住突破口。 Youthful academy students, controlled nonlethal exercise, no UI.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded Action. Transition in: continues Scene09 tactical action geography. Transition out: cuts to the next tactical action beat. Screen/camera rule: Blue Lions pressure expands from southeast/central lane; Golden Deer side pressure and Black Eagles adjustments remain geographically readable. Audio bridge: horn, training weapon clacks, bowstring, magic pressure, controlled breaths. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: Dimitri drives the Black Eagles front line back one measured step with nonlethal training force while Dedue seals the gap with his shield. The Black Eagles bend but do not break. Felix waits at the side rather than chasing.

negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; use controlled academy sparring only, no blood or lethal injury.
